_comment: Node agent (codexray-node-agent) — independent of the backend/frontend maps. Canonicalize git-blame author emails -> ClickUp member email. Departed contributors (vyas — author of the upstream import commit 67c8d5f and most early commits) are deliberately LEFT OUT so they route through `fallback` and get FLAGGED (matched:false) in the dry-run. `fallback` = the repo owner of record (Aishwarya, same as the backend map). Keep in sync with `git shortlog -sne HEAD` + the ClickUp roster.
